question: Should OpenClaw accept this restart-specific durable audit table with fixed 512-row retention now, or defer restart records into a broader audit-ledger design?
rationale: The code path appears coherent, but it creates a persistent local metadata contract and stores restart preflight/session-derived context, which is a maintainer/security policy decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix.

options.title: Accept restart audit table
options.body: Merge after conflict resolution with the current schema, redaction, retention, and post-transition write placement as the intended operator audit boundary.

options.title: Narrow persisted metadata first
options.body: Require a smaller persisted payload or stricter redaction contract before introducing durable restart audit state.

options.title: Defer to broader audit ledger
options.body: Pause this PR if restart audit events should wait for the separate metadata-only audit ledger direction instead of landing as a restart-specific table.

recommendation.title: Accept restart audit table
recommendation.body: Merge after conflict resolution with the current schema, redaction, retention, and post-transition write placement as the intended operator audit boundary.
